components.name: .📦 Page header contents
components.description:
The variants are guidelines as to how the Page header can be configured. 

The left side is the most prescriptive, but if you need custom content fro the right side, choose the `Time or Custom` option and replace the component with your own.

**Non-variant layers:**

- Return Button : Sits above the title indicating a return to the previous screen, usually one page up in IA hierarchy.

- Breadcrumbs : Page-level hierarchy to show location if it's too much to fit at the app header level.

- More right side buttons : Max 4 actions should be available in the right side content mainly for space.

- Extra content (children) : Content that sits between the description and the bottom tabs which extends fully side to side.
